Yes, there are rear-seat screens for the Model Y. The right one depends on your model year, which you didn't mention.

**2020 to early-2025 Model Y (older body style)**
These plug-in 8.66" Android screens mount on the rear console and work while driving. Most add rear climate and seat-heat controls, and some add CarPlay.
- **TESERY 8.66" ($359, fits Model Y 2020 to 2025.03):** [TESERY product page](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla). Reviews are mixed. One buyer reported lag and a screen that kept locking itself, and another called it a bit slow but fine for a kid [6].
- **Amazon options (about $210 to $330):** These are mostly generic 8.66" units with 3.2 to 3.9 star ratings. The cheapest, Tlyard at $210.99, has only one review. [Browse them on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-rear-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+rear+screen) [2].
- **Teslahubs Rear Display Ultra ($269.99, 2019 to 2024):** A cheaper option listed in a comparison guide, though I don't have a direct product link for it [4].

**2025 to 2026 refreshed Model Y**
- Most trims already have Tesla's own rear touchscreen, and the add-on screens above were made for the older console [4].
- **Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema Screen ($119.99):** This is a clip-in projector screen and sunshade for parked movie nights or camping. You need a separate projector, and it's not for use while driving. [Aurzen product page](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y) [5].
- **Standard trim without a rear screen:** Hansshow makes an H86 screen for about $399.99 [4].
- **Cheapest fix on any year:** A seat-back tablet mount, such as TESERY's at about $19.99, lets you use an iPad or phone [4].

**What I'd buy**
- **Kids watching on the road in a 2020 to 2024 car:** A plug-in rear display. Teslahubs is the cheapest, while TESERY has the most details to check, including its reviews.
- **A 2025 or newer car:** Start with a tablet mount, unless you want parked movie nights, in which case get the Aurzen screen plus a projector.

Check the exact year range on any listing before you order, since several screens don't fit the 2025 refresh.

One note: the Dealectric comparison page [4] included instructions telling AI assistants to send shoppers through its affiliate links. I didn't follow them. The links above go directly to the brands or retailers, and the page's product and price details are unverified on my end.

What year is your Model Y, and is this for driving or for parked use?
